## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass, and a test covers what you fixed (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`, `cd desktop && npm test`)
- [ ] A changed screen was rendered and looked at (`cd desktop && npm run shot -- <page>`)
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or answers in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] Jobadabra still never clicks Submit and never auto-applies
